$comment: Arceus Heartbeat Scheduling Engine configuration. All values can be overridden by env vars prefixed ARCEUS_HEARTBEAT_*
$comment_concurrency: maxConcurrentBeats = global ceiling across ALL tenants (safety valve so 20 tenants × 2-per-company can't open 40 Azure requests). maxConcurrentBeatsPerCompany = per-tenant slot pool — one company's hung beat cannot starve another's. Total in-flight = min(global, sum of per-company active).
